619059630d1f.text: AI Is Getting Good at Math. Here’s Why.. In May, an internal model at OpenAI found a counterexample to Erdős's unit distance conjecture . Open since 1946. Many experts had tried to prove it. OpenAI found a counterexample instead. A month later, OpenAI published a proof of the Cycle Double Cover (CDC) problem , then solutions to ten more open problems by July. And a proof of Navier Stokes in September. Anthropic published a formalization of the fermat's last theorem , and advanced bounds on Reimann's hypothesis . The models are suddenly good at math. The question that interests me is whether we can predict what kinds of problems these models will solve. What makes a problem tractable for an…
